kept.name: qwen38-27b-200k-on-16gb
kept.reason: Step-by-step recipe for Qwen 3.8 27B at about 196K context on a 16GB card. Its usage notes also cover 24GB (3090 Ti, 262K) and long-context results for agentic coding.

kept.name: llama-cpp-adaptive-kv-streaming
kept.reason: llama.cpp fork that stores the KV cache in host RAM and streams it to the GPU. It runs Qwen3.8-27B at 256K context on 16GB VRAM, which suits the 64GB-RAM laptop.

kept.name: strata
kept.reason: One-click Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE engine for 12-24GB GPUs. Its benchmarks used 64GB RAM, the same as the user's laptop, and include 128K-context decode speeds and dual-24GB data.

kept.name: large-moe-consumer-hardware
kept.reason: Guide to running a large Qwen3.8 MoE on a 16GB GPU using llama.cpp --cpu-moe. Includes KV cache sizing at 262K context and memory budgeting.

kept.name: freetoken
kept.reason: MoE engine for models bigger than VRAM. It caches experts on the GPU and reuses context checkpoints for agentic work, and serves Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible APIs. Another option for the 16GB laptop.

kept.name: kv-cache-vram-sizing
kept.reason: Formula for estimating KV cache memory. Needed to work out how much context fits at 16, 24 and 48GB.

kept.name: on-prem-llm-deployment-architecture
kept.reason: Usage notes give an exact 24GB RTX 4090 llama-server config for Qwen3.8-27B at 196K context, with agentic coding benchmark results.

kept.name: unsloth
kept.reason: Source of the GGUF quants. Notes compare Qwen3.8-27B quant quality against size on a 16GB card (Q4_K_M, IQ4_XS, UD-Q3) and report that mixed-precision Q4 behaves well in agentic use.

kept.name: local-model-picks-2026
kept.reason: Model picks by memory size, plus Qwen 3.8 27B setup advice (Q4 weights with Q8 KV cache) and a comparison with 35B-A3B on low-VRAM setups that have 64GB RAM.

kept.name: qwen3-6-27b
kept.reason: Model card background for the Qwen 3.6 to 3.8 line: 262K context, YaRN context extension, tool-call parser, MTP and coding sampler settings.

kept.name: pi-coding-agent
kept.reason: Lightweight coding agent built for local models. Notes cover Qwen 3.8 tips, KV cache quant pitfalls, and tool-call loops at Q4/90K versus Q8 on 48GB.

kept.name: local-model-harness-patterns
kept.reason: Lessons from running Qwen 3.8-27B locally as a coding agent: delegate to subagents, detect loops at 100K+ context, and tune the cache to avoid reprocessing prompts.

kept.name: claude-code-local-model-switching
kept.reason: How to point Claude Code at a local Ollama or LM Studio model, including the KV-cache fix (CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0) that matters for long-context agentic use.

kept.name: lm-studio
kept.reason: Easy GUI and API server for local models, with VRAM-fit estimates, GPU offload controls and a context-length setting. Useful for checking what fits at each card size.

kept.name: llmfit
kept.reason: Detects the machine's hardware and ranks which models and quants will fit, including context length. Directly helps with picking models at 16, 24 or 48GB.

kept.name: qwen3-8-27b-uncensored-hauhaucs-aggressive-gguf
kept.reason: Lists file sizes for every Qwen3.8-27B quant (Q2 10.7GB to Q8 31.5GB) and the model's architecture details, which helps match quants to cards. Caveat: this build has its safety refusals removed, so use it as a size reference rather than a model to run.

kept.name: state-of-open-coding-models-2026
kept.reason: Useful context: the strongest open coding models no longer fit on consumer hardware, which helps set realistic expectations at each card size.
